capabilities: Chat with local Ollama models in a sidebar panel with streaming responses
Run editor commands on selected text to summarize, explain, fix grammar, or generate stories
Switch models and customize system prompts in settings
Test the Ollama server connection from settings
Use quick prompt chips for common actions in the chat panel
extras: Works on mobile only if Ollama is hosted on the local network with OLLAMA_HOST=0.0.0.0; the README includes manual installation steps and a Ko-fi support link.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to run local LLM models on notes, so users must switch to separate tools to chat with or transform their text.

relations.evidence: Connect seamlessly to your local or self-hosted Ollama instance and interact with models directly inside your notes

summary: Local LLM plugin that connects to an Ollama server for a sidebar chat panel and in-note AI commands like summarize, fix grammar, and explain.
